A voltage regulating circuit consisting of Zener diode, having break-down voltage of 10 V and maximum power dissipation of 0.4 W , is operated at 15 V . The approximate value of protective resistance in this circuit is $\_\_\_\_$ $\Omega$.
questions.solution:
Maximum current the Zener can safely carry: $I_{max} = \dfrac{P_{max}}{V_Z}$
$I_{max} = \dfrac{0.4\ \text{W}}{10\ \text{V}} = 0.04\ \text{A}$
The protective series resistor takes the extra voltage: $V_R = 15\ \text{V} - 10\ \text{V} = 5\ \text{V}$
This same maximum current flows through the resistor, so $R = \dfrac{V_R}{I_{max}}$
$R = \dfrac{5\ \text{V}}{0.04\ \text{A}} = 125\ \Omega$
Answer: 125
